section-1-1.TO: — (a) prepare a police covenant report, and (b) lay a copy of the report before Parliament

section-1-3.TO: have regard in particular to— (a) the obligations of and sacrifices made by members of the police workforce, and (b) the principle that it is desirable to remove any disadvantage for members or former members of the police workforce arising from their membership or former membership

section-1-4.TO: ensure that the views of— (a) any relevant government department, and (b) anyone else the Secretary of State considers appropriate, are sought in relation to the matters to be covered by the report

section-1-5.TO: set out in full or summarise any views obtained under subsection (4)

section-1-6.TO: include in a police covenant report a summary under subsection (5)
section-1-6.UNLESS: the person whose views are summarised has approved the summary

section-1-7.TO: state whether, in the Secretary of State’s opinion, in respect of any matter covered by the report, members or former members of the police workforce, or a particular description of such persons, are at a disadvantage when compared with other persons or such descriptions of other persons as the Secretary of State considers appropriate

section-1-8.TO: set out the Secretary of State’s response to any such disadvantage as mentioned in subsection (7)
section-1-8.WHERE: the Secretary of State’s opinion is that there is any such disadvantage as mentioned in subsection (7)
